title: Ready-to-wear looks
caption: Dress your hero in one click, from knights and rangers to starship crews, space marines and a neon-lit Glow runner.

title: Centaurs and more
caption: New species join the builder, like the centaur, and they wear the same outfits as everyone else.

title: Birds take flight
caption: Rebuilt birds like the bald eagle glide on spread wings, with feathers, talons and a pose for every move.

title: Rebuilt vehicles
caption: Motorcycles, trucks and rovers come with body styles and wheel sizes you can tune with a few sliders.

title: Trees in bloom
caption: Plant cherry, jacaranda and magnolia trees that change with the seasons and sway in the wind.

title: Faces with feeling
caption: Export a face sheet of eight expressions straight from your 3D character, each one clear at RPG Maker's face size.

title: Paint roads on 3D maps
caption: Drag the Path tool to lay dirt roads, cobblestone or paving that follow the hills through your village.

title: Search everything
caption: Type a word in the new toolbar Search to find maps, switches, items and event text, grouped and one click away.
